items.raw_excerpt: Public schools in the ACT have received their budgets for next year, with a change in the way their funding is calculated, seeing a number of colleges facing a reduction.
items.summary_en: Public schools in the Australian Capital Territory got their budgets for next year. A new funding formula means several schools will receive less money. The teachers' union says it was not consulted about the changes.
items.summary_ko: 호주 수도특별지역 공립학교들이 내년 예산을 통보받았으나, 예산 산정 방식이 바뀌면서 다수 학교가 예산이 줄어들게 됐다. 교사노조는 변경 과정에서 사전 협의가 없었다며 반발하고 있다.
items.title_en: ACT Public Schools Face Budget Cuts After Funding Formula Change
